name: PHP
blurb: First language learned in my career, used in many projects and frameworks.
description: First language learned in my career, used in many projects and frameworks. I feel comfortable using this language and it is my main language for backend development.

name: TypeScript
blurb: Used as the main language across recent Next.js, Nuxt, and SaaS projects.
description: Learned by practice and projects that needed to be done with, all the Nuxt projects were done using TS as the main language, and most recently I participated in a project in Next.js where everything was done with this language.

name: JavaScript
blurb: The bedrock. Comfortable from vanilla DOM up through the latest ES proposals.
description: Third code language learned in the beginning of my career. Realized at the moment that this was the language I needed to excel to become a better developer.

name: HTML
blurb: Foundation of every page. Semantic markup for accessibility and SEO.
description: First code language ever learned related to the coding of web pages and applications.

name: React
blurb: Self-taught initially, then production at BAM, AppFire, Wing, Brownkind.
description: Learned on my free time when there were no projects in React in my company, later proposed to work on an internal project with it, and finally helped in a web app and the BAM project with Next.js.

name: Vue
blurb: First reactivity framework. Solid across Vue 2 → 3, Pinia, Composition API.
description: At my first job, I started learning and using Vue for a client with an e-commerce section. It was my first entry into the world of reactivity. Nowadays I consider myself very solid with this technology.

name: Next.js
blurb: SSR, SSG, app-router. AppFire pulled 95+ Lighthouse with this stack.
description: Started using this framework for a project using its different capabilities — helped me do SSR, integrate different tools, and achieve excellent performance scores.

name: Nuxt.JS
blurb: Vue 3 framework — used on the Vue iteration of BAM.
description: This framework over Vue 3 was used for the Vue version of our BAM system, as per request of our client. Used in only that project but got the hang of it.

name: CSS
blurb: Grid, Flexbox, custom properties, animations — proficient from scratch.
description: Second code language ever learned. I see myself as very proficient with CSS, using CSS Grid and Flexbox extensively.

name: TailwindCSS
blurb: Utility-first CSS — what this very portfolio is built with.
description: Learned about it in a project where I helped with logic bugs, and decided to use it for my portfolio.

name: Sass
blurb: Variables, mixins, loops to mass-generate utility classes. Pre-Tailwind era.
description: Used with Foundation for almost all my projects. So useful to have variables in a file and use them throughout the whole project. Also used loops to create several classes at a time.

name: Foundation
blurb: Grid framework used across many early client projects.
description: I feel comfortable using this framework — used it in many of my projects and it helps with responsiveness.

name: GSAP
blurb: Parallax, letter reveals, X-axis scroll. Heavy use on butchershop.co.
description: First used with WordPress for fade-in animations, then pushed much further on butchershop.co — parallax, letter animations, X-axis scrolling and more.

name: Framer
blurb: Nocode + code components on Wing. PNG sequences and timed scroll.
description: Started working with nocode frameworks this year for Wing.com. Mixed nocode with code components at the end — a pretty solid tool.

name: Laravel
blurb: PHP framework. APIs, auth, Eloquent across 3+ web apps.
description: This framework and language (PHP) were learned at the same time at my first job. Built 3+ web apps using this tech stack for the backend and API creation.

name: Node.js
blurb: Bug-fixing and refactor work, then ported full app to Vue at Priio.
description: Worked on a project with a Node app — learned it to fix bugs and make refactors, which we later transcribed to Vue. This was the Priio app.

name: Express
blurb: MERN-stack personal projects.
description: Started studying and using it for a personal project with the MERN stack.

name: GraphQL
blurb: Strapi + Next consumption. Cleaner queries, only what you need.
description: Used with Strapi to make requests cleaner and enabled the team to only get exactly the data that we needed.

name: MySQL
blurb: Relational DB. Migrations, models, relations, cascades.
description: Started using this relational database management system with Laravel. Learned about models, migrations, relations, cascades and more.

name: MongoDB
blurb: NoSQL — studying for an upcoming personal project.
description: Learning and studying it because I wanted to learn about a No-SQL DB to complement my MySQL experience. Planning on using it on a personal project.

name: Algolia
blurb: Instant search. Implemented on the RockCreek Group site.
description: Learned to use it for a project with a big database to make requests almost instantly. Implemented on the RockCreek Group project.

name: WordPress
blurb: First CMS. ACF, flexible content, custom themes — Tebra, Grail, RockCreek.
description: My first CMS. Used throughout my career to create many sites using flexible content, ACF, and tools such as Algolia and GSAP.

name: Statamic
blurb: CMS over Laravel — Butchershop.co. Custom blueprints + Vue components.
description: CMS mounted over Laravel used for the Butchershop.co website. Capable of creating blueprints of elements — a great CMS for custom Vue components on the frontend.

name: Strapi
blurb: Headless CMS for the BAM backend. Compact, easy.
description: Headless CMS used for the backend part of the BAM project. Needed a compact, easy-to-use headless CMS and this fit perfectly.

name: Shopify
blurb: Custom themes. Liquid templating with React islands.
description: Gained experience in creating custom Shopify themes and utilized the Liquid templating language to develop more interactive and dynamic online stores.

name: Figma
blurb: Source of truth for handoff. Wireframes through final.
description: Learned to use this app to create wireframes and used it day-to-day as the source of truth to create excellent looking websites and web apps.

name: Airtable
blurb: Scripts + automations. Built an HR tool and a production data extension.
description: Learned about scripts and automations for an HR project. In January 2024 I created an extension script for a company to collect data in the production process.

name: Zapier
blurb: Paired with Airtable for HR interview workflows.
description: Learned how to use it with Airtable for an internal project for the HR department to send invitations to interviewees and interviewers.
